children: Triveni Power Transmission Ltd (TPTL), the demerged power transmission business of Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd, has listed its equity shares on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and National Stock Exchange (NSE), marking its transition into an independently listed entity.
The listing follows the demerger of Triveni Engineering's power transmission business under a scheme approved by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), which became effective on May 19, 2026.

Under the arrangement, eligible shareholders of Triveni Engineering received one equity share of TPTL for every three shares held in the parent company as of the record date, July 22, 2026. The company has listed 10.48 crore equity shares with a face value of Rs 2 each on the two exchanges.
The restructuring is aimed at establishing Triveni Power Transmission as an independent business, allowing greater operational focus, transparent performance assessment and opportunities for growth.

TPTL manufactures high-speed gearboxes and power transmission equipment for industrial applications. The company is part of the Triveni Group, which also has a significant presence in the sugar industry.
The independent listing separates the power transmission business from Triveni Engineering's broader operations, providing investors with direct exposure to the industrial equipment manufacturer.
